context.post_text: Instagram prioritizes recommended Reels over followed accounts. That reduces creators' organic reach and pushes them toward paid promotion, while keeping viewers scrolling longer.
Instagram is expanding teen account protections: under-16s will need parental approval to livestream, and messages from strangers will be blocked by default.
Instagram resets my feed from Following to recommendations every time I reopen the app. It makes keeping up with people I follow harder and exposes me to more sponsored posts.

TikTok gives new accounts distribution through recommendations, while Instagram still relies more on existing follower relationships. That difference affects which platform small creators choose first.
